subject: [PATCH v2] memcg: trim the per-cpu charge stock instead of draining it

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies the per-cpu charge stock in Linux's memory cgroup (memcg) to trim excess charges instead of draining them completely. This change addresses a performance issue where an application's request/response traffic pattern caused excessive CPU usage due to continuous thrashing of the percpu stock. The patch introduces two new watermarks, MEMCG_STOCK_LOW and MEMCG_STOCK_HIGH, which are used to determine when to trim the charge stock. When the cached count exceeds the high watermark, only pages above a lower threshold (MEMCG_STOCK_LOW) are returned, rather than completely emptying the cache.
